title: Sleepy peacock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail fan -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='34' ry='22' fill='#1f7a6b'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='27' ry='16' fill='#2fa58f'/>
    <!-- eyespots -->
    <circle cx='28' cy='66' r='5' fill='#3b2f8f'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='66' r='2.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='60' r='5' fill='#3b2f8f'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='60' r='5' fill='#3b2f8f'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='66' r='5' fill='#3b2f8f'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='66' r='2.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  </g>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='13' ry='16' fill='#1c56b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#2f7de0'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='45' y='52' width='10' height='18' rx='5' fill='#1c56b0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='11' fill='#2f7de0'/>
  <!-- crest -->
  <line x1='50' y1='37' x2='47' y2='31' stroke='#2f7de0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='37' x2='50' y2='30' stroke='#2f7de0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='37' x2='53' y2='31' stroke='#2f7de0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='30' r='2' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='29' r='2' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='30' r='2' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M60 49 L68 51 L60 53 Z' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eyes -->
  <path d='M43 46 Q46 49 49 46' stroke='#bff0e6' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 46 Q55 49 58 46' stroke='#bff0e6' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#e884b0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#e884b0'/>
</svg>
